page.content:
Airy spirit who serves Prospero and earns freedom at the play's end.

How Ariel connects

  • Work: The Tempest — Ariel is the spirit who serves Prospero in The Tempest.
  • Character: Prospero — Ariel works the storm and the masques at Prospero's command.

What is Ariel?

Ariel is the spirit Prospero freed from a tree and bound to service: the agent of the tempest, the harpies, and the songs, released when the duke drowns his book.

Key threads lead to The Tempest and Prospero.
